CustomField.description: This field aggregates the sum of all rent installments from the associated Payment Plan Schedules. It was created to replace the static 'RentForPeriod' formula field, ensuring that the exact prorated contract value is accurately reflected based on the generated payment plan.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This amount is automatically calculated by summing up the total rent installments from your generated payment plan. It represents the exact prorated rent for this specific contract duration.
CustomField.label: Total Rent For Period
